about.label: About
about.p1: I'm <1>Dominique Mariah Valter</1>, a Full Stack developer passionate about technology, problem-solving, and digital experiences.
about.p2: My work combines building complete applications with a particular interest in creating interfaces that aren't just good-looking, but also <1>interactive and memorable.</1>
